record.edic_text:
3820 palaios {pal-ah-yos'}

from 3819; TDNT - 5:717,769; adj

AV - old 18, old wine 1; 19

1) old, ancient
2) no longer new, worn by use, the worse for wear, old

For Synonyms see entry 5816

same.cexp: 在古時候，以前；一向；已經，…很久了
作廢，當作舊的；＜被＞變舊，破舊
